## About
This repository contains the container images with entire toolchain for Autorest CLI [autorest.cli](https://github.com/Azure/autorest.cli) and Python SDK. These tools can be used by Python SDK owners and Azure CLI developers.

To learn more about the Azure CLI, refer to [http://aka.ms/cli](http://aka.ms/cli).

## Featured Tags

- `0.1.0` ```docker pull mcr.microsoft.com/azure-cli/tools:0.1.0``` 

## Usage
```
docker run -it mcr.microsoft.com/azure-cli/tools:<version>
```
For more instructions on how to use this image refer to [Docker Tools Cheatsheet](https://github.com/Azure/autorest.cli/blob/master/doc/A3-docker-tools-cheatsheet.md).

## Support
If you encounter any bugs with the tool, please file an issue in [GitHub](https://github.com/Azure/autorest.cli/issues/new).

## Feedback
Please provide feedback to [Feedback](https://github.com/Azure/autorest.cli/issues).
